summary.text: Jaclyn Zimmermann is a Democratic state representative who has represented Missouri House District 98 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is an attorney who has practiced primarily in employment law.

paragraphs.text: Jaclyn Zimmermann was born in Rolla, Missouri, and graduated from Steelville High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Missouri State University in 2002 and a law degree from the University of Missouri-Kansas City School of Law in 2005.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Zimmermann said she lives in Manchester, Missouri, with her husband, Todd, and three sons, and has been an attorney for more than 20 years.
She listed her campaign messages as funding public schools and teacher pay, wages and the cost of groceries and health care, and support for abortion access following the 2024 vote in Missouri.
